_evidence: MEASURED (config.json + configuration_illada.py + modeling_illada.py source + tokenizer.json + all 4 safetensors headers + a FULL byte-exact SHA256 comparison of the embed_tokens/lm_head tensor pair, not a shape-only guess). Zero mlx/torch load, zero HCLI resident contention.
_label: Odyssey I DISCOVERY. Second masked-diffusion specimen this session (after Dream-v0-7B) -- a direct, README-documented successor to LLaDA-8B, explicitly benchmarked against Dream-7B by its own authors. Real cross-checkable comparison point, not a repeat of the same architecture.

identity.name: GSAI-ML/iLLaDA-8B-Base
identity.paper: arXiv:2606.25331 'Improved Large Language Diffusion Models' (per README)
identity.provenance_note: configuration_illada.py's own copyright header reads 'Copyright (c) 2025 ByteDance Ltd.' despite the model being published under org GSAI-ML -- a real, verified-from-source provenance detail (shared/derived codebase lineage), not independently explained further this pass.
identity.predecessor_per_readme: LLaDA-8B (same lab) -- README ships a direct architecture AND benchmark table against it plus Dream-7B and Qwen2.5-7B

architecture_CONFIRMED_FROM_SOURCE.family: Bidirectional (non-causal) masked diffusion transformer -- is_causal=False confirmed directly in modeling_illada.py's SDPA call, and _prepare_4d_attention_mask never forces a triangular mask. Standard GQA dense transformer otherwise (RMSNorm, SiLU MLP, RoPE) -- same 'diffusion behavior lives in generation, not weight shape' pattern as Dream-v0.

GENERATION_ALGORITHM_HONEST_GAP.finding: UNLIKE Dream-v0-Instruct-7B (whose HF repo bundles generation_utils.py with the complete denoising loop, letting this session verify the mechanism directly from source), iLLaDA-8B's repo ships ONLY the model architecture (modeling_illada.py has forward-pass/attention code, NO generate()/_sample() method at all -- verified by direct grep, not assumed). The README explicitly defers to an EXTERNAL GitHub repo (github.com/ML-GSAI/LLaDA) for 'generation scripts such as generate.py', which is NOT present in this ModelLake specimen's directory.
GENERATION_ALGORITHM_HONEST_GAP.consequence: the masking/confidence-unmasking SCHEDULE (almost certainly similar in spirit to Dream-v0's topk-confidence transfer, per the shared 'masked diffusion LM' lineage and the paper's own comparison table) cannot be verified from local files the way Dream-v0's was. This is an HONEST GAP, not filled by assumption -- a real difference in how much this specimen's generation behavior can be trusted sight-unseen vs Dream-v0's.

mask_token.note: present in tokenizer.json's added_tokens (128 total reserved special tokens, many unused '<[PLHDnnn]>' placeholders) but NOT surfaced as a top-level config.json field the way Dream-v0 exposes mask_token_id directly -- a caller must know to look in the tokenizer, not the model config.

TIED_EMBEDDINGS_BYTE_VERIFIED.method: full SHA256 of the complete embed_tokens.weight tensor (shard 1) vs the complete lm_head.weight tensor (shard 4), not a shape-only or partial-read comparison
TIED_EMBEDDINGS_BYTE_VERIFIED.finding: the tie_word_embeddings=true flag is GENUINE, not vestigial (contrast with Dream-v0's use_cache=true, which this session found WAS vestigial) -- confirmed by exact byte match, not just matching shape. But the checkpoint still MATERIALIZES the tied weight TWICE on disk: 1212.0 MiB stored as lm_head.weight is a pure, verified duplicate of embed_tokens.weight (7.7% of total checkpoint bytes). A loader that materializes lm_head as a reference/alias instead of a second on-disk copy would eliminate this exactly, at zero capability cost -- a concrete, verified 'obvious representation opportunity', not a guess.

byte_accounting_EXACT.finding: the RAW on-disk sum (8.2505B) is 8.28% off README's 7.62B -- a gap large enough that, on any other specimen this session, would have been flagged as unexplained rather than reported. The cause is exactly the tied/duplicated lm_head.weight verified above: dropping ONE copy of the embedding matrix brings the LOGICAL param count to 7.6150B, 0.065% from README's stated figure. Reporting only the raw stored-bytes sum without this reconciliation would have been a genuine, avoidable error in this receipt.

obvious_representation_opportunities: lm_head.weight is a verified, exact, 100%-redundant copy of embed_tokens.weight -- 7.7% of total checkpoint bytes recoverable at ZERO capability cost by aliasing instead of duplicating at load/pack time. This is a DIFFERENT class of saving than anything Gravity has attacked this session (quantization-free, exact, not a capability tradeoff at all -- pure redundancy elimination).
same dense-GQA-transformer argument as Dream-v0: every prior dense-architecture Gravity rule plausibly transfers to the WEIGHTS; the generation-time behavior is the orthogonal, unverified axis here.
failure_modes_not_yet_tested: No verification of the actual generation/unmasking algorithm -- the honest gap above is the single largest open question for this specimen.
README benchmark numbers (MMLU 74.8 etc.) are the AUTHORS' OWN reported figures, not independently reproduced by Hawking -- cited as provenance context, not verified capability.
preliminary_disposition: RESEARCH SPECIMEN. Genuinely useful as a SECOND diffusion-LM data point alongside Dream-v0-7B (same session) -- confirms bidirectional attention + standard dense weights is a REPEATED pattern across at least two independent diffusion-LM lineages (Dream-org and GSAI-ML/LLaDA), strengthening the 'Gravity priors transfer to diffusion-LM weights unchanged' hypothesis this session first raised for Dream-v0 -- though the generation-mechanism verification gap means that specific hypothesis remains ONE-SPECIMEN-VERIFIED (Dream-v0's source), one-specimen-UNVERIFIED (this one) rather than confirmed twice.

preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.resident_candidate: UNCLEAR, SAME OPEN QUESTION AS DREAM-V0: depends entirely on whether the (unverified here) generation loop can run with few enough steps to compete with causal decode wall-time for HCLI's short bounded outputs -- untested for BOTH diffusion specimens this session found.
preliminary_star_resident_evaluation.verdict: NO CLAIM BEYOND 'a genuine second diffusion-LM data point, generation mechanism unverified unlike Dream-v0' -- Odyssey I discovery only.
